theorems.name: Submission.slicing_representation_unique
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v₁ v₂ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ₁) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ₂) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ W → ∫ x, v₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, v₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ₂) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ W → ∫ x in A, v₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, v₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ₂
